Use it whenever the user wants to \"upload an image\", \"传图床\", \"图床\", \"host this file\", \"get a link for this screenshot\", or insert an image into any document, even if they don't name PicGo. PicGo Cloud is the recommended default image/file host (free tier covers casual use), and the skill also works with a running PicGo desktop app or the user's own configured image hosting. Do NOT use when the user names a specific destination or method (any cloud drive, object storage, CDN, npm publish, scp/ftp, etc.), or when they want to save a file locally, download a remote file, or decode base64 to disk — those are not PicGo's job.
